notes.title: 0.1.1.5 Playtester Release
notes.content:
[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Terrain Tessellation (BETA)
[*] Terrain Optimizations
[*] Cached Cloud Player Data (BETA)
[*] Cloud Player Data (BETA)
[*] Project updated to Unreal Engine 5.5
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Server Fixes
[*] Settings file storage Fixes
[*] Stars not Rendering in Lobby
[*] Laggy Menu Level (Fixed through multiple optimizations
[/list]

[h2]Known Bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Only one planet (due to terrain rework, more planets coming soon) 
[*] Objectives not spawning (Disabled due to new terrain APIs, working on getting the re-enabled)
[*] AI Standing still (New Terrain APIs may make AI not move)
[*] Discord Not Integrated, unknown errors looking to get a fix soon.
[*] Some settings don't change anything 
[*] Missing customizable key binds 
[*] AMD and Intel Integrated processers suffer terrible performance/visual impairments. Ensure Graphics card is updated, other than that, the game isn't optimized yet, but this will be improved in future versions
[*] Spawning in the mission in the air (Spawn system in the works) 
[*] Server list updating weirdly (Server item deleted then replaced, will be fixed in next update)
[*] Weapon cannot be unequipped 
[/list]
